percent-off-calculator.formula:
Discount amount = price x discount% / 100
Final price = price - discount amount
howTo: Enter the original price in the first field.
Set the discount percentage with the slider or type it directly.
Read how much you save and the final price instantly.
Try different discounts to compare offers.
Use the final price to check your bill at checkout.
keyFacts: A percent-off sale reduces the original price by a fixed percentage.
The discount amount is always calculated on the original price, not on the reduced price.
Two stacked discounts multiply, they do not add — two 20% discounts equal 36% off.
A 100% discount means the item is free; 0% means no discount.
The final price can never go below zero.

limitations: It does not add sales tax or shipping — those must be applied separately.
Stacked coupons need to be entered one at a time, in the right order.
Rounding may differ by a cent from store systems.
It cannot judge whether a deal is genuinely good value.

percent-off-calculator.quickAnswer: A percent-off calculator finds the sale price in seconds. Multiply the original price by the discount percentage, divide by 100 to get the savings, then subtract that from the original price. The result is what you actually pay.
percent-off-calculator.tagline: Find the sale price and your savings in seconds.
percent-off-calculator.workedExample:
A jacket costs $80 and is on sale at 25% off.

Discount amount = 80 x 25 / 100 = $20.
Final price = 80 - 20 = $60.

You save $20 and pay $60 — a genuine quarter off the original price.
